title: Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement actions with former employee of Regions Bank and former employee of United Community Bank
raw_text:
August 20, 2026
Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement actions with former employee of Regions Bank and former employee of United Community Bank
For release at 11:00 a.m. EDT
The Federal Reserve Board on Thursday announced the execution of the enforcement actions listed below:
Consent prohibition against Stephanie R. Kilbert
Former employee of Regions Bank, Birmingham, Alabama
Misappropriation of customer funds
Consent prohibition against Crystal A. Wykle
Former employee of United Community Bank, Greenville, South Carolina
Misappropriation of customer funds
Additional enforcement actions can be searched for here.
